floorsNote: Reviewed minimum suite/test counts for the full Jest run. Intentional reductions weaken the mass-test-loss guard and require an explicit reviewed change.

entries.rationale: 20k-session memory measurement; correctness is covered by ordinary backup suites and the probe is expensive.
entries.testFullName: 20k-session large-backup behavior verifies at scale and reports measured footprint

entries.rationale: Opt-in quest evaluation A/B measurement; timing is machine-relative and is not a correctness gate.
entries.testFullName: perf quest eval A/B (opt-in via PERF_PROBE=1) compares engine scan vs partitioned single pass in-process

entries.rationale: Opt-in history-read/export performance baseline; timing is machine-relative and is not a correctness gate.
entries.testFullName: perf baselines (opt-in via PERF_PROBE=1) measures history-read costs at 5k and 20k sessions

entries.rationale: Opt-in progression/achievement sync measurement at 100 to 20k sessions; timing is machine-relative.
entries.testFullName: perf sync scans (opt-in via PERF_PROBE=1) measures quest/achievement sync costs at 100 / 1k / 5k / 20k sessions

entries.suitePattern: perf: projection vs legacy read cost
